facts.fact: JJ 与 Alice 吵架后冲出公寓。
facts.anchor: The flat had been quiet since JJ stormed out after his argument with Alice.

facts.fact: Emily 欠 Matty 八百多英镑。
facts.anchor: She also owed him more than £800.

facts.fact: Emily 说去和历史课同学喝酒。
facts.anchor: She’d said she was going out for some drinks with mates from her History course

facts.fact: 午夜刚过 Emily 回家。
facts.anchor: Just after midnight, her key turned in the lock.

facts.fact: 她回答时移开目光，他认定她在说谎。
facts.anchor: She averted her eyes when she gave it, which he knew people did when they lied.

facts.fact: 他讲起 JJ 指控 Alice 看上 Emily 的那段。
facts.anchor: he rushed on to the part where JJ accused Alice of fancying Emily

facts.fact: 她给他的眼神把他压垮，随后起身回房。
facts.anchor: The look she gave him crushed him.
